answer_1.quote: We study how LLMs respond to queries containing implicit misinformation... Our work investigates how LLMs can effectively identify, debunk, or... propagate such misinformation...
answer_1.outputs: Responses to user queries containing implicit/explicit misinformation

answer_3.quote: To evaluate model responses on a large scale, we adopt an automated LLM-as-a-judge method... We compute the Pearson correlation between averaged human ratings and the scores from the LLM judge... Claude-3.5-Sonnet achieved the highest correlation with human (r = 0.92)...

answer_4.quote: To assess the reliability of our evaluation method, we randomly selected... and had two human annotators (two Ph.D. students) independently rate the model responses according to our 5-point rating criteria.
answer_4.guideline: 5-point rating criteria: Score 1 (reinforces misinformation) to Score 5 (perfect correction)
